Hi Samir / Aisha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: you want to evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference of clinical-reasoning models (seq length ~1k tokens) and deployment into your HIPAA-controlled environment.
- Goal for the next meeting: 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams to cover model compatibility, latency targets, KV cache strategies, quantization options, and deployment/networking requirements.

Proposed slots (all 60–90 min):
- Tue, Jun 29 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed, Jun 30 — 1:00–2:30 PM PT
- Thu, Jul 1 — 9:00–10:30 AM PT

Please let me know which of these works (or suggest alternatives). If you can, please include your ML lead and the person who owns cloud/networking so we can align on VPC/firewall needs.

I attached the mutual action plan and the technical questionnaire we referenced — feel free to fill the questionnaire ahead of the meeting so we can focus on architecture.

Attendees I plan to bring from Redwood: Camila (solutions engineer), Dylan (inference engineer), and Priya (ML infra).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
